svg.title: One Dollar is all you need story, scene 01: The dollar
svg.desc: A dark red gallery. Under a spotlight, a green cartoon one-dollar bill with a big 1 hangs framed under glass behind a velvet rope, and a dashed arrow marked SEED points at it. A small card under it reads ONE DOLLAR, PLEASE DO NOT TOUCH. On the right, a big heap of pink tokens is marked THE TOKEN 1.
